steps.question: Which rare deer is saved at Kanha and is the State Animal of M.P.?

questionMeaning.hi: कौन सा दुर्लभ हिरण कान्हा में बचाया गया और म.प्र. का राजकीय पशु है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kaun sa durlabh hiran Kanha mein bachaaya gaya aur M.P. ka raajkeeya pashu hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The barasingha (swamp deer) is the State Animal of Madhya Pradesh. Kanha saved it from dying out.

modelMeaning.hi: बारहसिंगा म.प्र. का राजकीय पशु है। कान्हा ने इसे ख़त्म होने से बचाया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Baarahsingha M.P. ka raajkeeya pashu hai. Kanha ne ise khatm hone se bachaaya.

steps.question: Why is Madhya Pradesh called the ‘Tiger State’?

questionMeaning.hi: म.प्र. को ‘टाइगर स्टेट’ क्यों कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: M.P. ko ‘Tiger State’ kyon kehte hain?

options: It has the most tigers in India.
steps.answer: It has the most tigers in India.
